$comment: The most each public page may ship on its first load, in bytes, compressed (gzip for text; fonts as served), by kind and in total. scripts/check-performance-budget.mjs measures the built output against it on every pull request (Checks, 'Public site checks'), from the files a page's own HTML names, not from a timed run, and fails naming the page and the kind. scripts/performance-budget.mjs says what counts as first load. Scripts, styles, fonts and data were set on 2026-11-23 from what the build then shipped (after the front page became the list of starter canvases), plus 5%, rounded up to 100 bytes: a budget holds a page where it is, it does not say the page is light enough (lane A makes the heavy ones lighter, and lowers the limits as it does). The data counted is the manifest, which grows a little with each dataset and field, so it has a ceiling of 8,000 bytes on the pages that read it. A page's own HTML has one ceiling for every page, 30,000 bytes: the words on a page are not what makes it slow, and a limit of a few bytes over today's text would fail every time a sentence is added. The total is the sum of the kinds. The /build/ page only sends a visitor on to the canvas (src/pages/build.astro): 650 bytes of script today, 700 with 5%, and it reads no data. To raise a limit, say why in the pull request. The styles of a reading page were raised from 5,600 to 5,800 bytes on 2026-11-24 for the dark theme (its tokens and the toggle's styles, 5,706 bytes measured), and are 5,600 again, 5,302 measured, now that the font files are no longer folded into them. The theme's script sits in each page's head as text, so it is part of the page's own HTML and not a script file: reading pages still ship no script file. node scripts/check-performance-budget.mjs --propose prints the numbers for the build in front of it. Fonts: every page is given the Latin face and the macron face of both typefaces, 46,728 bytes today and 49,100 with 5%, because a page of New Zealand English and te reo Maori (its macrons) can load both; the accented letters of the Latin-1 range are a third file that only a page with one loads (scripts/subset-fonts.mjs, src/styles/site.css). Before the fonts were cut down to the characters the site uses the figure was 299,908 bytes. The scripts of /canvas/ are the island's own code, the drawing library and the chunks the first chart needs, 265,728 bytes measured on 2026-11-24 and 279,100 with 5%, down from 301,878; the editing tools, My canvases and the renderer of each chart type are fetched later and are not counted. The data limit stays at the 8,000 bytes the manifest may grow to; the files the canvas asks for when it opens on its own chart are asked for by script and are not counted. Data: the budget counts what a page's own HTML names, which is the manifest; data a script asks for after it starts (the events file and one data file when the canvas opens, about 34 KB) is not counted.
